Prevention: Avoid planting materials obtained from infected plantations
Monitoring: Monitor regularly for the presence of the banana aphid ( Pentalonia nigronervosa ), vectors of
Leaf edges roll upwards and show marginal yellowing
Infected banana plants usually will not fruit
Infected stools produce many small suckers
Currently the pest is not a danger in
Rwanda because the environment is not good for the pest’s development (low temperatures and high altitude) but the pest status is being monitored.
Direct Control: Infected bananas should be uprooted chopped and destroy plant residues
Remove plants surrounding the infected stool
Avoid any movement of planting material from infected areas (Quarantine)
Restrictions: It is preferable to use cultural practices (uproot and bury infected banana plants
and carry out phytosanitation practices for keeping clean banana field).
